scope: Cancellable MCP/GitHub/provider/fetch transports, MCP response validation and cancellation cleanup.

release_latency.scope: Release binaries against local HTTP fixtures. MCP cancellation endpoint deliberately delays its reply by 1200 ms. Stop includes journal checkpoint and quiescence; GitHub measures local cancellation while a fixture holds its response. Shared host; not production-network or worst-case latency guarantees.

checks: Local Stop finishes before the remote cancellation acknowledgement; DELETE follows cancellation cleanup.
A timed-out external request is issued once, receives one cancellation notice and is never replayed.
Pre-cancelled calls issue neither tools/call nor a fictitious cancellation; completed remote errors leave connections reusable.
Empty SSE priming frames precede a valid JSON-RPC tool response without failure.
Wrong JSON-RPC versions, missing results and ambiguous result/error envelopes are rejected.
Pre-cancelled GitHub/fetch/provider operations do not dispatch; cancelled GitHub writes report uncertain outcome and do not replay.
limits: HTTP cleanup is best effort, bounded to five seconds for cancellation and five seconds for subsequent session deletion; remote effects may have completed or may continue.
No layout changes: preceding visual sweep remains recorded in coder-reliability-qa.json.
Live Claude reasoning/compaction remains unverified after prior HTTP 429 responses; no additional live quota used this audit.
No weeks-long live soak or zero-defect claim.
